units: <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:18">Ab. IV, 18</cite> <he>אל … בשעת קַלְקָלָתוֹ</he> do not strive to see thy neighbor at the moment of his disgrace.

<cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 3:7">Hor. III, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Horayot 13a:8">13ᵃ</cite>) <he>בזמן ששניהם עומדים לק׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>בק׳</he>) when both (a man and a woman) are exposed to disgrace (prostitution, v. <cite ref="S01269"><he>קָלוֹן</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:3">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>בק׳ מתחילים וכ׳</he> in degradation (punishment) the beginning is made with the lowest, opp. <he>גדולה</he> elevation; Sifra Sh’mini, Milluim; <cite ref="Berakhot 61a">Ber. 61ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בקללה</he>); <cite ref="Taanit 15b">Taan. 15ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 102b:6">Snh. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>הוא היה תחלה לק׳</he> he (Jeroboam) initiated corruption (idolatry).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 109b:10">B. Bath. 109ᵇ</cite> <he>תולין את הק׳ במקולקל</he> every corruption is fastened to the corrupt (is named after him who started it).
<cite ref="Berakhot 60a:23">Ber. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>ואל … דבר ק׳ ועון</he> that no mischief or sin may occur through me; a. fr.
